# Jared Furtado

> Jared Furtado is a full-stack engineer based in Goa, India, and a third-year Computer Engineering student at Goa College of Engineering (2024–2028). He builds and ships web applications — paid client work, campus tools, and hackathon projects — and is currently moving into DevOps and infrastructure. He takes freelance projects and is looking for internships, particularly on the backend and infrastructure side. He is not looking for full-time roles while studying.

## Positioning

Jared is a full-stack engineer who is learning DevOps, not a DevOps engineer. His production experience is in web application development and deployment. The infrastructure work — Go services, containers, CI/CD, infrastructure as code, observability — is in progress and is presented on his site as a learning track rather than as delivered experience.

## Core Expertise (backed by shipped code)
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Redux
- Backend: Node.js, Express.js, Go (in progress)
- Data: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase, Drizzle ORM, Prisma
- Python: computer vision with OpenCV, MediaPipe and YOLO
- Deployment and SEO: Vercel, schema markup, Open Graph, robots.txt, sitemaps
- Testing: Playwright

## Currently learning
Go, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, Linux, Terraform, Kubernetes, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry.

## Client work
- **Global Tourist Centre website rebuild** (https://globaltouristcentre.com/) — rebuilt a live Goa tourism operator's site in Next.js with internationalisation for German, French, Russian and Italian, a persistent WhatsApp Business enquiry widget, and conversion-focused landing page work.
- **TechJeeva** (https://findfund.vercel.app/) — a searchable directory of Indian government funding schemes and grants for founders, built for FIIRE (Forum for Innovation, Incubation, Research and Entrepreneurship). React with the Google Apps Script API.

## Projects
- **Campus Exchange** (https://campus-exchange-nu.vercel.app, https://github.com/jjf2009/Campus-Exchange) — a marketplace for Goa College of Engineering students to buy and sell used academic equipment and hostel items. No payment rail; the seller's WhatsApp contact is revealed once a request is accepted. Next.js 15, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, Playwright.
- **HeatWatch** (https://heat-watch-two.vercel.app, https://github.com/jjf2009/heat_watch) — urban heat island analysis fusing NASA MODIS satellite data with ground telemetry through an ONNX model. Built by a four-person hackathon team; Jared worked on the data pipeline and mapping frontend.
- **RideBuddy** (https://github.com/jjf2009/RideBuddy) — campus carpooling for GEC students with live location, Firebase auth and Leaflet routing. Built for the InternSpirit hackathon.
- **IntentOS** (https://github.com/jjf2009/IntentOS) — an intent-driven interface on Tambo AI that generates workflows and UI from natural language. No hosted demo.
- **OpenCV Projects** (https://github.com/jjf2009/OpenCV_Projects) — local computer vision tools using YOLO and MediaPipe.
- **Beacon** (private repo) — an uptime and incident platform in progress. The Go API over PostgreSQL works; the monitoring worker, alerting and observability stack are not yet built.
